title: Dating when he heard Armstrong with Fletcher Henderson
summary: Schaap uses Armstrong leaving Henderson in November 1925 to establish that Waters heard him at the Lafayette Theater and came to New York with Johnson in 1925.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: You heard Louie Armstrong with Fletcher Henderson?
Yeah, yeah -
Where did you hear that?

Well, I think I heard that - I don't know, wait a minute, did I - no at that, no, not at that period, not at '24. See, [ ], we were playin' the show every day, you know, we were workin', you know, see -
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82
Uh huh -
I heard Fletcher when I came here to live, from Atlantic City, you understand what I mean?
Well, when was that?
Ah, a couple of years later, that's all, '25.
Did you see Louie Armstrong with Fletcher Henderson?

With, yeah, I saw Louie Armstrong with Fletcher Henderson, yeah - wait a minute, at that, I didn't hear him in the '24. But I saw Louie Armstrong with Fletcher Henderson at the Lafayette Theater for the first time.
When, in '25?
Well I can tell you that Louie left Fletcher Henderson's band the first week of November 1925 -
OK. Well, that could be it, too, in '25, November is near the end.
Let me ask you a question to help us -
Near the end of, it's near the end -
You joined Charlie Johnson the summer of '25 in Atlantic City.
'Round that time or '26 or something like that, I can't pinpoint -
Well, the reason why I think it can't be '26, you see what I'm saying - if you heard Louie Armstrong with Fletcher Henderson, right?
Yeah -
That's true, you did hear Louie Armstrong -
Yeah, at the Lafayette Theater, yeah -
Right. Well, that event had to have taken place before the first week of November of '25.
Well, that's easy, I mean November is nearly the end of '25.
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82

Well, that's what I'm saying, 'cause it's not only easy, all I gotta do is, I gotta straighten out the years for you. If you joined Charlie Johnson in 1926 it wouldn't be easy, because it'd already be past, that's why I'm saying -
Well, it could have been '25, yeah -
That's what I'm saying, it's more likely -
Because after this show that I came here, when I went back to Boston I had no job, see what I mean? So it's very easy that I could have, you know what I mean -
But the first time you were in New York was this two week period, right?
Yeah.
And the next time you were in New York you came with Charlie Johnson.
Yeah, from Atlantic City.
Right. So if you didn't hear Louie with Fletcher during those two weeks, then you would have had to come with, to New York with Charlie Johnson before November of '25.
Could have been, easy. I take it it was before '25, because in '26 and '27 we were recording. See, we were recording with Charlie Johnson.
Right.
Yeah, it should. So he sure wasn't recording in Atlantic City, you know what I mean? So easy, it's easy to be that '25 since I recollect -
OK -

Know what I mean, yeah, easy, because we was to record. We went from New York to Camden, we were down there in New Jersey, but we went from New York to Camden, New Jersey at Victor to record at the head office, we were from New York to do that. So it would have to be '25, see what I mean, late '25 or somethin', or -
Right -
